inputs: The four 80-bit-key PRESENT test vectors from the paper/ISO Annex B
expected: Encryption matches all four ciphertexts and decryption recovers all four plaintexts
limitations: Four fixed 64-bit vectors; not a full key-size or message-length matrix.

inputs: The all-zero 80-bit key and the 128-bit key 00112233445566778899aabbccddeeff
expected: The 80-bit schedule yields final round key 6dab31744f41d700; the 128-bit schedule yields first/last keys 0011223344556677 and 091989a5ae8eab21
limitations: Two fixed keys; the 128-bit values are checked against the published Sage example, not an independent ciphertext vector.

inputs: Every 4-bit S-box input and every 64-bit permutation basis
expected: The inverse S-box and inverse pLayer recover every input
limitations: Structural inverses only; not a security property.

inputs: Plaintexts 0000000000000000 and 0000000000000001 under the all-zero 80-bit key
expected: After one S-box/pLayer step the states differ in 2 bits; after the full 31 rounds they differ in 32 bits
limitations: One fixed one-bit difference; it demonstrates diffusion, not a differential attack.
